title: Trump, Zelensky clash over diesel deal as Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 21, including children
summary: US President Donald Trump on Saturday told reporters that Ukraine should "get a new president", adding that his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky had disobeyed his orders not to strike Russian refineries.
